paragraphs.source_en: This was the residence of Hisamatsu Yajirō Toshikatsu, lord of Agui Castle, who had just been elevated to the title of Governor of Sado. Autumn had arrived, and more than eight months had passed since Odai married into this house. The residence stood on level ground, and its defenses were even weaker than those of the Bear Residence. Her husband Toshikatsu had gone to Nagoya the previous day and had yet to return.
